Manchester United striker completes transfer as Michael Carrick's target falls through

Manchester United completed the signing of a striker, according to reports. Michael Carrick, the club's director of football, was unable to secure a "real deal" signing in the same transfer window. The Daily Mirror reported that Carrick missed out on the deal. The Independent noted that the transfer raised questions about Carrick's budget rebuild strategy. Both reports indicate the striker's arrival proceeds while Carrick's target did not materialize.
